title: PalmPilot HUB: CALIBRATE button, USB-UART to laptop
notes: PalmPilot HUB, bench plan. Pins match PalmPilot CLAUDE.md section 2; not checked on hardware. Laptop link: USB data cable from the DevKit port labelled UART (on-board USB-to-UART bridge on UART0, 115200 baud) to the laptop; it also powers the hub. GPIO43 (U0TXD) and GPIO44 (U0RXD) are highlighted because the bridge uses them: do not wire them. No flex sensors and no motion sensor on the hub. Hands reach the hub over BLE only. GPIO10 reserved: leave disconnected.
